description: Title: Tech Zephyr 4.0 CP Contest — IIT Bhubaneswar Participation Type: Individual (1 Member) Eligibility: Open to all college students. About the Competition: Welcome to the Tech Zephyr CP Contest! Get ready to test your algorithmic thinking, problem-solving speed, and coding proficiency. This competitive programming contest is designed to push your limits with a series of challenging problems ranging from basic data structures to advanced algorithms. Whether you are a seasoned competitive programmer or a beginner looking to test your skills, this is your chance to shine on the leaderboard! WhatsApp Group Competition Format: Participation: Individual only (no team participation). Duration: 135 minutes (2 hours 15 minutes). Problem Set: 4 to 6 coding problems of varying difficulty levels (Easy to Hard). Languages Supported: C, C++, Java, Python, and other standard languages supported by the GFG practice portal. Mode: Completely Online. Rules and Guidelines: Individual Effort: This is a solo competition. Discussing problems or sharing code with others during the contest is strictly prohibited. Plagiarism: All submissions will be run through a strict plagiarism checker on the GFG platform. Any participant found using AI tools, copying from the internet, or sharing code will be immediately disqualified. Evaluation: Problems will be evaluated automatically against hidden test cases. Standard competitive programming scoring applies (based on the time of submission and the number of incorrect attempts). Decisions: The decisions made by the organizing committee regarding test cases, scoring, and disqualifications will be final and binding. Prizes Worth: ₹15,000 INR Instagram link : https://www.instagram.com/techzephyr.iitbbs/ Ready to Code? 135 minutes. Algorithmic challenges. Pure coding brilliance. Think it. Code it. Prove your skills. Tech Zephyr — IIT Bhubaneswar

Title: Tech Zephyr 4.0 CP Contest — IIT Bhubaneswar

Participation Type: Individual (1 Member)

Eligibility: Open to all college students.

About the Competition: Welcome to the Tech Zephyr CP Contest! Get ready to test your algorithmic thinking, problem-solving speed, and coding proficiency. This competitive programming contest is designed to push your limits with a series of challenging problems ranging from basic data structures to advanced algorithms.

Whether you are a seasoned competitive programmer or a beginner looking to test your skills, this is your chance to shine on the leaderboard!

  • WhatsApp Group

Competition Format:

  • Participation: Individual only (no team participation).
  • Duration: 135 minutes (2 hours 15 minutes).
  • Problem Set: 4 to 6 coding problems of varying difficulty levels (Easy to Hard).
  • Languages Supported: C, C++, Java, Python, and other standard languages supported by the GFG practice portal.
  • Mode: Completely Online.

Rules and Guidelines:

  • Individual Effort: This is a solo competition. Discussing problems or sharing code with others during the contest is strictly prohibited.
  • Plagiarism: All submissions will be run through a strict plagiarism checker on the GFG platform. Any participant found using AI tools, copying from the internet, or sharing code will be immediately disqualified.
  • Evaluation: Problems will be evaluated automatically against hidden test cases. Standard competitive programming scoring applies (based on the time of submission and the number of incorrect attempts).
  • Decisions: The decisions made by the organizing committee regarding test cases, scoring, and disqualifications will be final and binding.

Prizes Worth: ₹15,000 INR

  • Instagram link : https://www.instagram.com/techzephyr.iitbbs/

Ready to Code?

135 minutes. Algorithmic challenges. Pure coding brilliance.

Think it. Code it. Prove your skills.

Tech Zephyr — IIT Bhubaneswar
